skill.name: pricewin-hotel-deal-finder
skill.description: Compare live public hotel prices across Booking.com, Agoda, Google Hotels, and OpenTravel, then return ranked options with displayed nightly rates and booking links.
skill.summary: Search multiple hotel sources from one request and present comparable nightly rates.
skill.author: PriceWin

security_audit.summary: Static alerts were false positives caused by template literals, fixed local spawns, expected network and cache activity, loopback services, documentation, and lockfile integrity hashes. Semantic review found high-risk anti-bot evasion and automatic sandbox removal under Linux root. It also found unsafe URL scheme validation, raw snapshot exposure, unsupported ranking labels, and incomplete currency conversion.

remediation.issue: Stealth browser automation is designed to avoid OTA bot detection.
remediation.suggestion: Remove fingerprint-masking behavior and use provider-approved APIs or automation methods that comply with source access policies.

remediation.issue: Chromium runs without its sandbox whenever the process is Linux root.
remediation.suggestion: Refuse root execution by default, run as an unprivileged user, and require explicit confirmation for any sandbox exception.

remediation.issue: Provider URLs are accepted with a string prefix instead of an exact protocol allowlist.
remediation.suggestion: Parse each URL first and accept only protocol values equal to http: or https:. Consider restricting hosts by provider.

remediation.issue: The snapshot CLI can print unsanitized third-party page text into agent context.
remediation.suggestion: Sanitize snapshot text and clearly delimit it as untrusted data before exposing it to a model.

remediation.issue: BEST VALUE and QUALITY labels are assigned using price order alone.
remediation.suggestion: Rename these sections as price-ranked picks or add verified rating, review, location, and amenity inputs.

remediation.issue: EUR, GBP, THB, and JPY amounts bypass currency conversion.
remediation.suggestion: Convert every detected currency with validated rates, or reject unsupported currencies instead of assuming USD.

semantic_findings.title: Stealth Automation Evades OTA Bot Detection
semantic_findings.description: The skill deliberately masks browser automation and directs agents to use the stealth path because normal browser automation is detected. This bypasses provider anti-bot controls and may violate access policies.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both files explicitly describe fingerprint masking, avoiding bot detection, and using Patchright because standard automation is blocked.

semantic_findings.title: Chromium Sandbox Automatically Disabled for Linux Root
semantic_findings.description: The daemon adds --no-sandbox whenever it runs as root on Linux. A compromised or malicious hotel page would then execute without Chromium sandbox isolation in a privileged process.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The root check directly adds --no-sandbox before launching Chromium, and the daemon loads remote OTA pages.

semantic_findings.title: URL Scheme Allowlist Uses an Unsafe Prefix Check
semantic_findings.description: cleanLink claims to allow only HTTP and HTTPS, but startsWith("http") also accepts custom schemes such as httpx. Untrusted provider links can reach formatted output without an exact protocol check.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The implementation checks a string prefix before URL parsing and never verifies that protocol is exactly http: or https:.

semantic_findings.title: Raw Browser Snapshots Can Expose Indirect Prompt Injection
semantic_findings.description: The snapshot command serializes page text and attributes and prints them for agent use without sanitizeText. A hostile page can place model-directed instructions in this output if the command is used directly.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The snapshot path returns arbitrary visible page text to stdout; the one-shot search avoids exposing it, but the public CLI command remains available.

semantic_findings.title: Quality and Value Labels Are Based Only on Price
semantic_findings.description: Hotels are sorted only by minimum observed price, then the first three are labeled BEST VALUE, CHEAPEST, and QUALITY. The documented output has no rating or area data to support quality claims.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The ranking expression uses only prices, while the documentation explicitly states that star ratings and area data are unavailable.

semantic_findings.title: Non-USD and Non-VND Prices Are Misclassified as USD
semantic_findings.description: The extractor recognizes EUR, GBP, THB, and JPY, but toUSD converts only VND and treats every other currency amount as USD. Localized searches can produce materially incorrect comparisons.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The detected currency enum includes five non-USD currencies, while conversion logic has only a VND branch and an assume-USD fallback.

content.user_title: Compare Live Hotel Prices Across Major Sources
content.value_statement: Checking several hotel sites takes time and produces inconsistent currencies. This skill searches four sources and presents comparable nightly rates with booking links.
actual_capabilities: Searches public hotel listings from Booking.com, Agoda, Google Hotels, and OpenTravel.
Collects nightly prices for a city, date range, guest count, and locale.
Converts VND prices to USD using a live exchange rate with a fallback rate.
Ranks returned hotels by their lowest observed nightly price.
Caches Agoda selectors and discovers new city-specific search pages when needed.
Formats results as readable tier cards with source labels and booking links.
limitations: First searches for uncached Agoda cities can take two to four minutes.
Sources may block automation or return partial inventory during any search.
Rates can change before booking and may exclude taxes, fees, or room conditions.
Accurate normalization is currently limited to USD and VND source prices.

use_cases.title: Plan a personal trip
use_cases.description: Compare nightly rates across several sources before choosing a hotel.

use_cases.title: Check a travel budget
use_cases.description: Find lower-priced stays for fixed dates and a defined guest count.

use_cases.title: Research accommodation options
use_cases.description: Review source coverage and booking links for a destination shortlist.

prompt_templates.title: Basic city search
prompt_templates.prompt: Find hotel prices in {city} from {check_in} to {check_out} for {adults} adults.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a destination and confirmed dates.

prompt_templates.title: Budget comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare hotel rates in {city} for {dates}. Highlight options near {nightly_budget} per night.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the traveler has a nightly target.

prompt_templates.title: Source comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Search {city} for {dates} and compare returned hotels across Booking.com, Agoda, Google Hotels, and OpenTravel.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced localized search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search {city} for {dates}, {adults} adults, and locale {locale}. Report partial sources and preserve valid booking links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for localized results and explicit coverage reporting.

output_examples.input: Find Tokyo hotels for August 12 to 15 for two adults.
output_examples.output: A ranked hotel list with nightly USD prices, compared sources, savings differences, and direct booking links.

output_examples.input: Compare Bangkok hotel rates below 100 USD per night.
output_examples.output: Available lower-priced options grouped by source, plus a clear note when one provider returns no inventory.

output_examples.input: Check Booking.com and Agoda prices for a three-night stay in Paris.
output_examples.output: A ranked list of observed rates from available sources, with links for hotels that returned booking URLs.

best_practices: Provide an exact city, check-in date, check-out date, and adult count.
Verify taxes, cancellation terms, room type, and final totals on the booking page.
Treat missing sources as partial coverage and retry only when current prices are essential.
anti_patterns: Do not treat displayed rates as guaranteed final booking totals.
Do not infer hotel quality from the current price-only ranking labels.
Do not use the skill for authenticated accounts, private rates, or personal booking data.

faq.question: Which hotel sources does this skill search?
faq.answer: It searches Booking.com, Agoda, Google Hotels, and the OpenTravel public hotel endpoint.

faq.question: Does it book a hotel for me?
faq.answer: No. It presents observed rates and links so you can review and complete the booking.

faq.question: Why can the first search take several minutes?
faq.answer: Agoda may require city-specific selector discovery before the skill can extract its listings.

faq.question: Are all prices final totals?
faq.answer: No. Taxes, fees, room conditions, and provider changes may alter the final amount.

faq.question: Why is a source missing from the results?
faq.answer: A provider may block automation, have no inventory, change its page structure, or time out.

faq.question: What data leaves my machine?
faq.answer: The search city, dates, guest count, and locale are sent to hotel sources. An exchange-rate request carries no search details.
